en: Improved the `/workflows` and `/mcp` lists: they page (PgUp/PgDn, Home/End) and take j/k and the mouse like other lists, their arrows follow `select:previous`/`select:next` rebinds, and `x` in `/workflows` stops the run the pointer is on
zh: 改进 `/workflows` 和 `/mcp` 列表：支持分页（PgUp/PgDn、Home/End），与其他列表一样支持 j/k 和鼠标操作，箭头键遵循 `select:previous`/`select:next` 的重新绑定，`/workflows` 中按 `x` 会停止指针所在的那次运行
